extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: freestyle BMX bike, approx. 1.5 x 0.8 x 1.0 m (L x W x H), 20 in wheels
extras.notes: front faces -Y; stands on both wheels, no kickstand; wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); bmx-bike_steering (fork, riser bar with crossbar pad, stem, grips, front pegs) has its origin on the steering axis, tilted 15 deg: rotate around (0, 0.259, 0.966) in Blender Z-up = (0, 0.966, -0.259) in glTF Y-up; bmx-bike_crank (arms, sprocket, platform pedals) has its origin in the bottom bracket, rotate around local X; rear pegs are fixed to the frame; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
